--- title: "[StepIntercept]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add a constant column with a fixed value. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/blob/examples-section/shoez/step_intercept.py#L67-L192){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python StepIntercept(value=1.0, name="intercept", role="predictor", id=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} A single constant column is added, by default a column of ones named ``"intercept"``. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [value]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1.0]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The constant to fill the new column with. Default ``1.0``. The column's dtype follows the literal, so an ``int`` gives an integer column. [name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["intercept"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Name of the new column. Default ``"intercept"``. A `Recipe` rejects the step if the frame already has a column of this name. [role]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["predictor"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Role intended for the new column. Default ``"predictor"``. [id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Stable step identifier. Default ``"intercept"``. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} A constant ``intercept`` column of ones is appended; the input columns pass through untouched: ::: {#1c462280 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} df = pd.DataFrame({"x": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]}) df ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
x
0 1.0
1 2.0
2 3.0
``` ::: ::: Specifying the step touches no data: ::: {#9558eefc .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} recipe = Recipe().add(StepIntercept()) recipe ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Recipe (untrained) Inputs: no roles assigned Steps: step_intercept() [untrained] ``` ::: ::: `fit()` has nothing to estimate; the step is constant: ::: {#1e4f87b4 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} fitted = recipe.fit(df) fitted ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` Recipe (trained) Inputs: 1 columns — 1 predictor Steps: step_intercept(intercept) [trained] ``` ::: ::: `transform()` appends the column: ::: {#e1f7cc21 .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} fitted.transform(df) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ```{=html}
x intercept
0 1.0 1.0
1 2.0 1.0
2 3.0 1.0
``` ::: ::: ``value`` and ``name`` control what is appended: ::: {#4bb3ada0 .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} recipe = Recipe().add(StepIntercept(value=0.0, name="bias")) fitted = recipe.fit(df) fitted.transform(df) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=6} ```{=html}
x bias
0 1.0 0.0
1 2.0 0.0
2 3.0 0.0
``` ::: :::
